description: Machine-readable routing manifest for small, reproducible context packets. Agents load only the sources assigned to their stage plus story-specific references.

product_context.purpose: Approved positioning, audience, demo narrative, and messaging guardrails

business_ask.purpose: Business problem, MVP outcome, scope, and open product questions

vision.purpose: Differentiation thesis and settled scope decisions

engineering_context.purpose: Implemented architecture, runtime flow, demo topology, boundaries, and local commands

system_inventory.purpose: Known integration targets and tenant-specific unknowns

technical_constraints.purpose: Fixed technical constraints and deployment open items

build_context.purpose: Standing stack, package, security, and coding invariants

implementation_spec.purpose: Normative product and runtime implementation specification

story_queue.purpose: Dependency-ordered build scope and acceptance criteria

discovery.objective: Understand product intent, stakeholders, current systems, constraints, and open questions without reading the implementation spec as the primary source.

requirements.objective: Convert approved discovery into traceable requirements using normative scope and current engineering constraints.

adr.objective: Make architecture decisions against the existing implementation, fixed constraints, requirements, and normative specification.

lld.objective: Produce implementable design consistent with accepted decisions, current architecture, requirements, and fixed build rules.

story_gen.objective: Generate a dependency-ordered queue aligned to product priorities, current architecture, accepted design, and testable requirements.

planning.objective: Decompose one story using current architecture and only the normative sources referenced by that story.

codegen.objective: Implement the approved plan using current package boundaries, coding invariants, and story-specific design references.

testgen.objective: Test the story against its acceptance criteria, plan, invariants, and referenced design decisions.

rfc.objective: Create the story audit summary from its plan, implementation, tests, and authoritative acceptance criteria.

shadow.objective: Compare old and new behavior using current system boundaries and approved release requirements.

review.objective: Audit implementation against engineering invariants, accepted design, requirements, and story evidence.

release.objective: Prepare and execute release using current topology, operational constraints, approved requirements, and validation evidence.

always_on_invariants: Runtime behavior is configuration-driven; no tenant or scenario-specific branches in the platform runtime.
Read connectors and action connectors are structurally separate.
Secrets never enter model context, logs, or evidence.
Every mutation follows ProposedAction -> PolicyEngine -> ApprovalGate -> ActionExecutor -> VerificationEngine -> EvidenceLedger.
Every execution-state transition persists state, emits a PlatformEvent, and appends Evidence.
Execution success is not remediation success until verification passes.
Agents load only their routed context packet; repository-wide rediscovery requires an explicit missing-context reason.
